title: Smart Buildings: AI-Powered Efficiency and Sustainability
description: A guide to AI in smart buildings — automated energy management, predictive maintenance, occupant comfort systems, and how intelligent infrastructure reduces costs and carbon.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in smart buildings, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in smart buildings for developers, site managers, architects, and readers tracking the built environment.
